units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. A ruling in an administrative offence case issued by a judge may also be appealed against to a higher court by the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record, or by the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.2. The issue of a temporary identity document for a stateless person in the Russian Federation to a stateless person subject to administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, the recognition of a person as a refugee, the receipt by a person of a certificate confirming consideration on the merits of an application for recognition as a refugee in the Russian Federation, or the grant of temporary asylum to that person in the Russian Federation entails review of the ruling in the administrative offence case imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation, upon a prosecutor’s protest or that person’s appeal, and (or) substitution of the penalty in the cases specified in parts 3.6 - 3.8 of Article 4.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Review of a ruling in an administrative offence case imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation is conducted in accordance with the procedure and within the time limits established by this chapter.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 30.1 · “Review of a ruling in an administrative offence case imposing…”

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. If an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is received both by a court and by a higher body or a higher-ranking official, the appeal shall be considered by the court.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: A decision shall be issued following consideration of the appeal.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.1 · “A decision shall be issued following consideration of the…”

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. A ruling in an administrative offence case connected with entrepreneurial or other economic activity by a legal entity or a person engaged in entrepreneurial activity without forming a legal entity shall be appealed against to an arbitrazh court in accordance with arbitrazh procedural legislation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. A procedural order refusing to initiate an administrative offence case, and the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code, shall be appealed against in accordance with the rules established by this chapter.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. The procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code may be appealed against by the body whose official drew up the administrative offence record (except where the procedural order was issued by that body), the persons specified in part 5 of Article 28.3 of this Code who drew up such a record, the prosecutor, the person against whom proceedings in the administrative offence case are being conducted, and the victim if participating in the case.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.1. Right to appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. The list of officials authorised to appeal, on behalf of the bodies specified in parts 1.1 and 5 of this article, part 5 of Article 30.9 and parts 4 and 5 of Article 30.12 of this Code, against a ruling or procedural order in an administrative offence case or a decision on an appeal against such a ruling or procedural order shall be established by the respective bodies.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30.1

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be lodged with the judge, body or official that issued the ruling and that must, within three days of receipt of the appeal, forward it together with all case materials to the appropriate court, higher body or higher-ranking official.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be lodged with the judge, body or official that issued the relevant procedural order and that must, on the day such an appeal is received, forward it together with all case materials to the appropriate court, higher body or higher-ranking official.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. An appeal against a judge’s ruling imposing administrative arrest shall be forwarded to the higher court on the day the appeal is received.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2.1. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation shall be forwarded to the higher court, higher body or higher-ranking official on the day it is received.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. An appeal may be lodged directly with the court, higher body or higher-ranking official authorised to consider it.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.1. Repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. - Federal Law of 07.04.2025 No. 59-FZ.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3.2. Appeals to a higher body or a higher-ranking official against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in parts 6 - 8 of Article 14.3.1, parts 4 - 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 and Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system shall be lodged electronically, including in the form of an electronic document.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. If consideration of an appeal is outside the competence of the judge or official to whom the ruling in the administrative offence case has been appealed, the appeal shall be forwarded within three days for consideration by the competent authority.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is not subject to a state fee.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.2. Procedure for lodging an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6. An appeal against a judge’s ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities shall be forwarded to the higher court on the day the appeal is received.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 30.2

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case may be lodged within ten days of service or receipt of a copy of the ruling.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code may be lodged within one day of the arrival (receipt) of the relevant procedural order from the judge, body or official considering the administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. If the time limit specified in part 1 or 1.1 of this article has been missed, it may, upon an application by the appellant, be restored by the judge or official authorised to consider the appeal.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. Appeals against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code may be lodged within five days of service or receipt of copies of the rulings.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.3. Time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. A procedural order shall be issued rejecting an application to restore the time limit for appealing against a ruling in an administrative offence case.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.3

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. In preparing to consider an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, the judge or official shall:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) establish whether there are circumstances precluding consideration of the appeal by that judge or official, and circumstances precluding proceedings in the case;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) decide applications and, where necessary, order an expert examination, request additional materials and summon persons whose participation in consideration of the appeal is deemed necessary;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) forward the appeal together with all case materials for consideration by the competent authority if its consideration falls outside the competence of the judge or official concerned.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.4. Preparation for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. In preparing to consider an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, and during its consideration, the judge, body or official shall decide on participation, through videoconferencing systems or a web-conferencing system, by persons whose presence is necessary when the appeal against the ruling in the administrative offence case is considered.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.4

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered within ten days of its receipt, together with all case materials, by the body or official authorised to consider the appeal.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1.1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered within two months of its receipt, together with all case materials, by the court authorised to consider the appeal.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. Appeals against rulings in cases concerning the administrative offences specified in Articles 5.1 - 5.25, 5.45 - 5.52, 5.56, 5.58 and 5.69 of this Code shall be considered within five days of their receipt, together with all materials, by the court authorised to consider the appeals.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative arrest or administrative expulsion shall be considered within one day of lodging the appeal if the person held administratively liable is serving administrative arrest or is subject to administrative expulsion.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4. An appeal against a ruling imposing administrative suspension of activities shall be considered within five days of its receipt, together with all materials, by the higher court authorised to consider the appeal concerned.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.5. Time limits for consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5. Appeals against the procedural orders specified in point 4 of part 1 of Article 29.4 and point 3 of part 2 of Article 29.9 of this Code shall be considered within one day of lodging such an appeal.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 30.5

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. An appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case shall be considered by a judge or official sitting alone.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2. When an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case is considered:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) it shall be announced who is considering the appeal, which appeal is to be considered and who lodged the appeal;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) the attendance of the individual, the individual’s statutory representative or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the case was issued, and of persons summoned to participate in consideration of the appeal, shall be established;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) the authority of the statutory representatives of the individual or legal entity, defence counsel and representative shall be verified;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) the reasons for the failure of participants in the proceedings to appear shall be ascertained, and a decision shall be taken to consider the appeal in their absence or to adjourn consideration of the appeal;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 5) the rights and duties of persons participating in consideration of the appeal shall be explained;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 6) challenges and applications submitted shall be decided;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 7) the appeal against the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be read out;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 8) the lawfulness and justification of the ruling issued shall be checked on the basis of the materials in the case and additional materials submitted; in particular, explanations shall be heard from the individual or the legal entity’s statutory representative against whom the ruling in the administrative offence case was issued; where necessary, testimony from other persons participating in consideration of the appeal, explanations from a specialist and an expert’s opinion shall be heard, other evidence shall be examined and other procedural actions shall be carried out in accordance with this Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 9) if a prosecutor participates in consideration of the case, the prosecutor’s opinion shall be heard.
units.label: Point 9 Part 2 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.6. Consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3. The judge or higher-ranking official shall not be bound by the arguments of the appeal and shall examine the case in full.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 30.6

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.label: Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1. Following consideration of an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case, one of the following decisions shall be issued:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 1) to leave the ruling unchanged and dismiss the appeal;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 2) to amend the ruling, provided that this does not increase the administrative penalty or otherwise worsen the position of the person against whom the ruling was issued;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 3) to quash the ruling and terminate proceedings in the case where at least one of the circumstances specified in Articles 2.9 and 24.5 of this Code exists, or where the circumstances on which the ruling was based have not been proved;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 30.7

units.locator: Article 30.7. Decision on an appeal against a ruling in an administrative offence case
units.text: 4) to quash the ruling and remit the case for fresh consideration to a judge, body or official authorised to consider it, where a substantial breach of the procedural requirements of this Code prevented a comprehensive, full and objective consideration of the case, or where it is necessary to apply a law on an administrative offence entailing a more severe administrative penalty if the victim in the case has appealed against the leniency of the administrative penalty imposed;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 30.7
